physicalNotes: Radius 0.19983976 Jupiter radii from Tuson et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.523.3090T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.523.3090T/abstract): 14,286.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.0178 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
